title: GAR retrieves assignment-scoped continuity deterministically
description: Remaining GAR continuity prerequisite from the 2026-09-01 archival plan, revalidated on 70c15583a6afa4aac9a6f6eb11abf840afa377a4. Authored only; not applied.

packets.title: GAR retrieves assignment-scoped continuity deterministically
packets.objective: Implement only the still-missing scoped-retrieval prerequisite from `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-01-global-agent-room-continuity-archival.md`; do not redo already-landed GAR-first receipt or final-handoff ordering. Add nullable `scope_key` to Agent Room messages with an index on workspace/scope/time. Extend the existing room post/reply/recent/inbox interfaces and existing seven MCP tools with optional scope only—no eighth tool. Replies inherit the parent scope when omitted. Define evidence-derived keys (`github:pr:<n>`, `github:issue:490:<lane>`, `git:branch:<branch>`) and keep unscoped announcements null. Retrieval by scope must find relevant handoffs regardless of unrelated room volume. Do not encode owner, lease, task state, priority, or scheduler semantics into scope; GAR remains communication only. Preserve existing messages with NULL scope and current APIs when scope is omitted.
acceptance_criteria: A scoped handoff remains retrievable after at least 150 unrelated global messages.
Existing unscoped room behavior and message rows remain backward compatible.
Post/reply/recent/inbox accept optional scope; a reply inherits its parent scope unless explicitly rejected by validation.
The MCP surface remains exactly the existing seven tools; only optional fields change.
Scope keys contain no task/lease/scheduler authority and do not become a second ownership system.
Indexes make scoped retrieval bounded without scanning the full room history.
